name: Extremely Tough Jumping Swarm!
summary: A native-verified partial route collects 206 of the 376 required chips. The automatic cloners still prevent a complete route; neither a winning replay nor an impossibility proof is established.
limitations: No winning replay and no universal impossibility proof established. Data counts or unsuccessful play are not treated as impossibility.

experiments.result: Decoded both 1024-cell DAT planes and exact level metadata; initialized production MS runtime and rendered actual game sprites.
A short run collected 37 of the required 376 chips, then was cornered by the automatically cloned swarm near (0,10). This is an unsuccessful attempt, not an impossibility argument.

A bottom-first partial route collects 206 of the 376 required chips and is alive at (7,22) at tick 1395, but is then cornered. Its full initial state, 1,396 steps, and result match the original native engine; exact replay bytes were read and native stderr was empty. This is not a winning replay.

title: Extremely Tough Jumping Swarm!
